# List of Figures, Tables, and Apps

A consolidated index of every numbered figure and table in the book, plus the interactive Shiny apps. Click any entry to jump to it in context.

## List of Shinylive Apps

* @fig-app-srs — Shinylive app for simple random sampling.
* @fig-strat-app — Shinylive App for Illustrating Stratified Sampling.
* @fig-ratio-app — Shinylive App Illustrating Ratio Estimation and Regression Estimation.
* @fig-poststrat-app — Shinylive App Demonstrating Post-stratification of a Simple Random Sample.
* @fig-cluster-app — Shinylive App Comparing Two-Stage Cluster Sampling (ratio estimator) with SRS.
* @fig-ups-app — Shinylive App Comparing SRS (average and ratio) with UPSWR (Hansen–Hurwitz).

## List of Figures

### Data Analysis with R

* @fig-agpop-acres92-hist — Histogram of 1992 farm acreage
* @fig-agpop-acres-scatter — 1992 vs. 1987 farm acreage, with the 1:1 line
* @fig-agpop-scatter-highres — The saved high-resolution PNG, re-inserted
* @fig-log-acres-hist — Distribution of log(acres92): histogram with empirical density and normal fit

### Simple Random Sampling

* @fig-srs-simulation-distribution — Population distribution and sampling distribution of the SRS sample mean over 5000 repeated samples (n = 300)
* @fig-srs-coverage-intervals — First 100 simulated 95% confidence intervals for the SRS sample mean, with coverage failures highlighted
* @fig-srs-index — One realized population under the model.

### strata

* @fig-agpop-region-boxplot — 1992 farm acreage by region stratum
* @fig-agpop-region-compare-boxplot — Sampling distribution of the mean under SRS, proportional, and Neyman allocation (region strata, 2000 simulations)
* @fig-agpop-acres82-boxplot — 1992 farm acreage by acres82 quartile stratum
* @fig-agpop-acres82-compare-boxplot — Sampling distribution of the mean under SRS, proportional, and Neyman allocation (acres82 strata, 2000 simulations)

* @fig-agpop-ratio-simulation-boxplot — Estimator variance under repeated sampling: SRS vs. ratio estimator (2000 simulations)
* @fig-cherry-regression-fit — Cherry tree volume vs. diameter with the fitted regression line
